✨ discussion-downloader | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To easily export and archive Claude AI conversations in a structured Markdown format for personal notes, documentation, or further analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Saves entire conversations from claude.ai to Markdown • Preserves original formatting (code blocks, lists, tables) • Includes YAML header with metadata (title, source, model, dates, message count) • Generates a clean, understandable filename
📖 Summary: Discussion Downloader is a Chrome extension that allows users to save entire conversations from claude.ai into a Markdown file with a single click. It preserves the original formatting, including code blocks, lists, and tables, and adds a YAML header with metadata for easy organization.
